Players Committee card image of [[Dryden Vos]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploys -2 if Maul on table. When deployed, may ▼ a weapon on Vos. While armed and present at a site, opponent may not 'react' to or from here. Immune to attrition < 5 (< 3 if with Qi'ra).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Dryden%20Vos.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Dryden Vos.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
